title: RF_NOISE_MAP
description: Per-bin noise floor, quiet level and occupancy of one scan entry, published by AcquisitionApp every <noise_map><every_sweeps> sweeps when <noise_map><enabled> is true. Point i covers [f_start_hz + i*point_hz, f_start_hz + (i+1)*point_hz).

timestamp_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the window closed.

center_freq_hz.description: Centre frequency of the scan entry.

point_hz.description: Width of one point (one or more FFT bins).

sweeps.description: Sweeps of this entry in the window.

floor_db.description: Estimated noise floor, dBFS per FFT bin (mean over the window and over the bins of a point). The value detection compares against.

quiet_db.description: Each bin's own minimum level over the window, dBFS (maximum over the bins of a point). Equals the floor where the band is quiet; a continuous carrier or spur raises it. Reported only, never used for detection.

occupancy.description: Fraction of sweeps in which the bin exceeded floor + detection margin (maximum over the bins of a point).

dbm_offset_db.description: dBFS to dBm offset (<noise_floor><dbm_offset_db>), when configured: dBm = dBFS + dbm_offset_db.
